description: Replace an idle definition with a candidate from another definition root, retaining the old version for rollback.

defs.description: Absolute path to the live definition root.

target.description: Relative definition directory; no absolute path, empty or dot-prefixed segments.

from.description: Absolute candidate definition root containing the same target.

daemons.description: Daemon directories to query; defaults to AOS_DAEMON, or none when unset. An empty array checks none.
